dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped motifs with sharp high-contrast perimeters; pixel gradients transition abruptly from low-intensity exterior to high-intensity rings, many of which enclose a lower-intensity central core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, asymmetrical clusters of solid high-intensity pixels lacking internal gradients, distributed primarily between the larger macro-annuli in the mid-body region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent central macro-annuli form an irregular quadrilateral with an elongated horizontal axis and acute angles on the posterior-most vertices.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of elongated, high-intensity linear filaments originating from the lower-right ventral boundary and extending into the surrounding black negative space.
